measured.dps_window_note: Engaged = damage over runs of hits with no gap above 15s, lasting 20s or more. Four shipped meters use four denominators; a DPS figure without its window is not a measurement.
measured.stance_evidence: 64.2% even damage across 120 non-crit melee hits (killing blows excluded). Balanced prints ~50%, Offensive ~93%. Distance: 3.1 SE from Balanced, 6.3 SE from Offensive. Neither signature is within 2 SE, so the stance is NOT identified.
